XP-01.choice: Accept proposal: Each programme keeps its own vocabulary in its own ledger. The tracker stores one canonical state per item and shows the native label through the fixed mapping table (tracker section 'Status mapping'). The ASPEII↔IP mapping in aspeii-implementation-plan.md §8 is applied unchanged. Only the native 'done' value (ASPEII VERIFIED, CIP PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE, IP VERIFIED, GN COMPLETE) counts toward completion.

XP-02.choice: Accept proposal: Store the IP warrant status as the authoritative status and keep GN AssertionStatus as the neural-layer lifecycle field: GN PREDICTED = warrant PREDICTED (operator class MODEL); GN DERIVED = A1 COMPUTATION result (status = min of inputs, never above them); GN CONFIRMED = a new ATTESTED warrant by the human approver whose parents include the prediction warrant (REQ-VER-002), lineage retained; GN REJECTED = verification task RESOLVED_REFUTED (valid_to = now, refuted_by link). ASPEII classifies all of these as HYPOTHESIS unless independently verified. A neural path never writes OBSERVED (GN-002 constraint 2 and REQ-WAR-022 both hold).

XP-03.choice: Accept proposal: Bind IP component `neural-service` to `packages/eoip/neural/` in docs/ip/ip-binding-map.md. Invention 2 learned mode imports the GN-103/GN-104 encoders; no second encoder implementation. IP modules for inventions that are not encoders (drift, advisor, forensics …) live under `packages/eoip/neural/` subpackages named after the IP component.

XP-04.choice: Accept proposal: One registry: GN-007's extension of experiment_tracker.py is the KGF metadata store named in REQ-NEU-032 (no MLflow). Stage mapping CANDIDATE=candidate, ACTIVE=production, RETIRED=retired. Records carry the union of IP fields (REQ-NEU-030) and GN gate reports.

XP-05.choice: Accept proposal: Apply the conjunction: a model is promoted only when every IP gate and every GN-007 gate passes. Prior mode counts as the RuleBaseline for Invention 2. Neither threshold set is lowered.

XP-06.choice: Accept proposal: `POST /ask` is the user-facing route. GN-203 nl_bridge is the neural path of REQ-INV3-005(b) and must run through the checkpoint SDK so every answer carries a warrant. `POST /neural/ask` stays as the GN contract route and returns the same warrant id plus citations; both share one implementation.

XP-07.choice: Accept proposal: GN-004 FeatureStore is the single embedding store. It keys rows by the IP tuple (tenant, level, model_version, snapshot_version) and reaches the vector-store abstraction through an adapter; Procrustes matrices (REQ-NEU-021) are stored with the snapshot.

XP-08.choice: Accept proposal: Snapshot id = GN-005 content hash. The REQ-NEU-001 Parquet export is written under that id with metadata (graph_version, recorded_at, counts). ref-2026-10 remains frozen; new snapshots never overwrite it.

XP-09.choice: Accept proposal: Before use, add each package (and each model weight with its licence) to the GN licence table with tier and verdict after Legal review; record the DR id in the ledger. Until then the dependent requirement stays BLOCKED.

XP-10.choice: Accept proposal: Pre-resolved by aspeii-reqirements.md §2.1: they stay separate; admission checks both where applicable; a fact TTL never extends a worker lease.

XP-11.choice: Accept proposal: One transactional outbox publishes `kgf.graph.changed` (REQ-LSE-001). CIP adds the non-graph change kinds (access, policy, prompt, model, tool, evaluator) to the same outbox with the CIP-RQ-005 metadata. Lease revocation, CTAR intake and ASPEII admission invalidation are consumers of that one stream. Synchronous read denial on revocation (CIP-RQ-009) does not wait for any consumer.

XP-12.choice: Accept proposal: Apply the stricter rule: an undeclared action is IRREVERSIBLE in the IP checkpoint and, for ASPEII-enabled effects, R4-denied with no approval path until the tool declares its action class.

XP-13.choice: Accept proposal: Interpret 'never blocked' as never blocked because of weak epistemic status only. Authorization, derivation-guard, privacy and egress checks still withhold content at the answer checkpoint.

XP-14.choice: Accept proposal: Flag-off restores pre-feature IP behaviour for IP features only. ASPEII admission for ASPEII-enabled effects is independent of every `ip.*` flag. The kill-switch control (IP §17.3) runs with ASPEII effects disabled.

XP-15.choice: Accept proposal: Keep every native location. The consolidated ledger `docs/programme/programme-ledger.json` (schema eoip-programme-ledger-v1) records, per item, the native path and its SHA-256 digest. verify_programme_ledger.py recomputes the digests.

XP-16.choice: Accept proposal: Neither number is assumed. Count `find tests -name "test_*.py" | wc -l` at the Phase 0a baseline, record the number and the file list digest in the GN-010 ledger, and use that recorded number for GN-PH1.G05 and GN-SO-16.

XP-17.choice: Accept proposal: GN-706 belongs to Phase 2 (its gate already checks it). GN-705 is cross-phase: each budget row is measured in the phase that introduces the operation and the GN-705 ledger closes at final sign-off.

XP-18.choice: Accept proposal: An honest FAILED ledger resolves a requirement only where the requirement text allows that outcome (GN-103, 104, 201, 202, 302, 303, 402, 403, 502, 601, 702). A FAILED P0 requirement is recorded honestly and blocks programme completion (Phase 1 'stop and escalate').

XP-19.choice: Accept proposal: Nine processes. WP-24 builds REQ-PRC-001..006; WP-27, WP-28 and WP-29 build REQ-PRC-007, 008 and 009; screen 18.12 lists all nine.

XP-20.choice: Accept proposal: Primary seeded tenant id is `acme-demo`; isolation tenant is `beta-demo`.

XP-21.choice: Accept proposal: Before CIP code work starts, the owner records whether CIP work may branch and commit (and the naming scheme, e.g. `cip/P<n>-<name>`). Until then CIP work stays in Phase 0 (documentation and inventory).

XP-22.choice: Accept proposal: Default local everywhere. An external endpoint is used only when all hold: tenant data-sharing policy permits the data class for that endpoint (REQ-PLT-005), egress controls in packages/eoip/egress/ apply (GN-203), and the ASPEII hosted-model profile has an approved budget. IP features ship and are evidenced in local mode only.

XP-23.choice: Accept proposal: One signer service and one trusted-key manifest; IP tenant keys are entries in it. Rotation and revocation follow ASPEII-RQ-022 clause 2.

XP-24.choice: Accept proposal: ASPEII WP01 needs aspeii-research-analysis.md (AS-G01..G03 probes). Until supplied, WP01 gate stays BLOCKED; the probes listed in aspeii-implementation-plan.md §2.1 are the only probe definitions an agent may use.

XP-25.choice: Accept proposal: Pre-resolved by aspeii-reqirements.md §2.1: reuse the IP key; production deployments acknowledge effective retention explicitly; CIP purge and legal hold apply to warrants as to any artifact.

XP-26.choice: Accept proposal: Pre-resolved by aspeii-reqirements.md §2.1: keep the IP diversity check and also evaluate source-lineage independence for evidence.

XP-27.choice: Accept proposal: Pre-resolved by aspeii-reqirements.md §2.1: when the commitment concerns an ASPEII task, the fulfilment warrant must ground on the verified outcome record.

XP-28.choice: Accept proposal: The REQ-INV6-001 opt-in record (who, when, which classes) is the GN-703 consent record; GN-703 tests treat a tenant without that record as non-federated.

XP-29.choice: Accept proposal: The Wisdom decision trace is the only record of the decision's situation, rationale, options, precedents and outcomes. It references the ASPEII certificate, receipt and action digest and the IP warrant, escalation and deliberation by id; it never copies or re-signs them. W1 step 2 merges captures of one action from different paths into one trace.

XP-30.choice: Accept proposal: Ship with person calibration disabled (agents only). A tenant may enable it only after an owner decision that names the legal basis and the employee notice; records stay visible to the person unless they grant access; never used for personnel decisions.
